chunks: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for they will not be blamed.
ai.seo_question: Who are men permitted to have sexual relations with according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse delineates the exclusive domains of sexual permissibility for men, restricting them to lawful wives and concubines (those their right hands possess), a ruling deeply rooted in the pre-Islamic and early Islamic social structure. It concludes that those who remain within these boundaries are free from blame, a concept that Shia scholars often contrast with the broader permissibility for women, highlighting the specific accountability placed on men in this context.
